Match its gritty muted military pixel clusters and material palette. RUNNER: former West African urban delivery worker, deep brown skin, slim shoulders and forearms, faded blue-gray short work shirt, narrow muted ochre striped shoulder textile and small rust-red travel sling, charcoal trousers and worn running shoes; low aggressive forward-leaning eastward posture.
